# zlaqhb

> Equilibrates a complex Hermitian band matrix using the scaling factors in the vector S.

<section class="usage">

## Usage

```js
import zlaqhb from '@rreusser/blahpack/lapack/base/zlaqhb';
```

### Layout API

Takes a storage layout (`order`) and leading dimensions, like CBLAS/LAPACKE.

```js
zlaqhb( order, uplo, N, KD, AB, LDAB, S, strideS, scond, amax, equed ) → Complex128Array
```

| param | type | intent | shape | constraints | description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `order` | `Layout` | in |  | one of `'row-major'`, `'column-major'` | storage layout ('row-major' or 'column-major') |
| `uplo` | `MatrixTriangle` | in |  |  | `'upper'` or `'lower'` |
| `N` | `NonNegativeInteger` | in |  |  | order of the matrix A |
| `KD` | `NonNegativeInteger` | in |  |  | number of super-diagonals (upper) or sub-diagonals (lower) |
| `AB` | `Complex128Array` | in/out | `kd + 1 × N` |  | band matrix, dimension (LDAB, N) |
| ↳ `LDAB` | `PositiveInteger` | in |  |  | leading dimension of AB |
| `S` | `Float64Array` | in | `N` |  | scaling factors, length N |
| ↳ `strideS` | `integer` | in |  |  | stride for S |
| `scond` | `number` | in |  |  | ratio of smallest to largest scaling factor |
| `amax` | `number` | in |  |  | absolute value of largest matrix element |
| `equed` | `Array.<string>` | out |  |  | specifies whether or not equilibration was done. `'none'`: No equilibration. `'yes'`: Equilibration was done, i.e., A has been replaced by diag(S) * A * diag(S). |

<details>
<summary>Reference notes for each argument (the reference implementation's own documentation; 1-based indices)</summary>

- `uplo`: Specifies whether the upper or lower triangular part of the symmetric matrix A is stored.

  -   `= 'U'`: Upper triangular
  -   `= 'L'`: Lower triangular
- `N`: The order of the matrix A. $N \ge 0$.
- `KD`: The number of super-diagonals of the matrix A if `UPLO = 'U'`, or the number of sub-diagonals if `UPLO = 'L'`. $\mathrm{KD} \ge 0$.
- `AB`: On entry, the upper or lower triangle of the symmetric band matrix A, stored in the first `KD`+1 rows of the array. The j-th column of A is stored in the j-th column of the array `AB` as follows: if `UPLO = 'U'`, `AB(kd+1+i-j,j) = A(i,j)` for $\max (1,j-\mathrm{kd}) \le i \le j$; if `UPLO = 'L'`, `AB(1+i-j,j) = A(i,j)` for $j \le i \le \min (n,j+\mathrm{kd})$.

  On exit, if $\mathrm{INFO} = 0$, the triangular factor U or L from the Cholesky factorization $A = U^H \, U$ or $A = L \, L^H$ of the band matrix A, in the same storage format as A.
- `S`: The scale factors for A.
- `scond`: Ratio of the smallest `S(i)` to the largest `S(i)`.
- `amax`: Absolute value of largest matrix entry.
- `equed`: Specifies whether or not equilibration was done.

  -   `= 'N'`: No equilibration.
  -   `= 'Y'`: Equilibration was done, i.e., A has been replaced by $\operatorname{diag}(S) \, A \, \operatorname{diag}(S)$.

</details>

**Returns** `Complex128Array`: `AB`

**Throws**

- `TypeError` first argument must be a valid order
- `TypeError` second argument must be a valid matrix triangle
- `RangeError` sixth argument must be greater than or equal to `max( 1, N )` (row-major)
- `RangeError` sixth argument must be greater than or equal to `max( 1, KD + 1 )` (column-major)

### Strided (ndarray) API

Takes explicit strides and offsets for every array. Use it for views, sub-matrices and non-unit strides.

```js
zlaqhb.ndarray(
    uplo,
    N, kd,
    AB, strideAB1, strideAB2, offsetAB,
    S, strideS, offsetS,
    scond, amax,
    equed
) → Complex128Array
```

Matrix shapes are logical (rows × columns). The reference's leading dimension (`LDA`, …) is replaced by the two strides and the offset.

| param | type | intent | shape | constraints | description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `uplo` | `MatrixTriangle` | in |  |  | `'upper'` or `'lower'` |
| `N` | `NonNegativeInteger` | in |  |  | order of the matrix A |
| `kd` | `NonNegativeInteger` | in |  |  | number of super-diagonals (upper) or sub-diagonals (lower) |
| `AB` | `Complex128Array` | in/out | `kd + 1 × N` |  | input/output band matrix, dimension (LDAB, N) |
| ↳ `strideAB1` | `integer` | in |  |  | stride of the first dimension of `AB` (complex elements) |
| ↳ `strideAB2` | `integer` | in |  |  | stride of the second dimension of `AB` (complex elements) |
| ↳ `offsetAB` | `NonNegativeInteger` | in |  |  | starting index for `AB` (complex elements) |
| `S` | `Float64Array` | in | `N` |  | scaling factors, length N |
| ↳ `strideS` | `integer` | in |  |  | stride length for `S` |
| ↳ `offsetS` | `NonNegativeInteger` | in |  |  | starting index for `S` |
| `scond` | `number` | in |  |  | ratio of smallest to largest scaling factor |
| `amax` | `number` | in |  |  | absolute value of largest matrix element |
| `equed` | `Array.<string>` | out |  |  | specifies whether or not equilibration was done. `'none'`: No equilibration. `'yes'`: Equilibration was done, i.e., A has been replaced by diag(S) * A * diag(S). |

<details>
<summary>Reference notes for each argument (the reference implementation's own documentation; 1-based indices)</summary>

- `uplo`: Specifies whether the upper or lower triangular part of the symmetric matrix A is stored.

  -   `= 'U'`: Upper triangular
  -   `= 'L'`: Lower triangular
- `N`: The order of the matrix A. $N \ge 0$.
- `kd`: The number of super-diagonals of the matrix A if `UPLO = 'U'`, or the number of sub-diagonals if `UPLO = 'L'`. $\mathrm{KD} \ge 0$.
- `AB`: On entry, the upper or lower triangle of the symmetric band matrix A, stored in the first `KD`+1 rows of the array. The j-th column of A is stored in the j-th column of the array `AB` as follows: if `UPLO = 'U'`, `AB(kd+1+i-j,j) = A(i,j)` for $\max (1,j-\mathrm{kd}) \le i \le j$; if `UPLO = 'L'`, `AB(1+i-j,j) = A(i,j)` for $j \le i \le \min (n,j+\mathrm{kd})$.

  On exit, if $\mathrm{INFO} = 0$, the triangular factor U or L from the Cholesky factorization $A = U^H \, U$ or $A = L \, L^H$ of the band matrix A, in the same storage format as A.
- `S`: The scale factors for A.
- `scond`: Ratio of the smallest `S(i)` to the largest `S(i)`.
- `amax`: Absolute value of largest matrix entry.
- `equed`: Specifies whether or not equilibration was done.

  -   `= 'N'`: No equilibration.
  -   `= 'Y'`: Equilibration was done, i.e., A has been replaced by $\operatorname{diag}(S) \, A \, \operatorname{diag}(S)$.

</details>

**Returns** `Complex128Array`: `AB`

**Throws**

- `TypeError` first argument must be a valid matrix triangle

<section class="notes">

## Notes

-   `zlaqhb()` corresponds to the reference LAPACK routine [`ZLAQHB`](https://github.com/Reference-LAPACK/lapack/blob/v3.12.0/SRC/zlaqhb.f).

</section>

<!-- /.notes -->

<section class="examples">

## Examples

```js
import Complex128Array from '@stdlib/array/complex128/lib/index.js';
import Float64Array from '@stdlib/array/float64/lib/index.js';
import zlaqhb from '@rreusser/blahpack/lapack/base/zlaqhb';

// 4x4 Hermitian band matrix (upper, KD=1, LDAB=2):
// Diagonal entries have small imaginary parts (will be zeroed by Hermitian scaling)
const AB = new Complex128Array( [ 0.0, 0.0, 4.0, 0.1, 1.0, 2.0, 9.0, 0.2, 3.0, 4.0, 16.0, 0.3, 5.0, 6.0, 25.0, 0.4 ] ); // eslint-disable-line max-len
const S = new Float64Array( [ 0.5, 0.25, 0.2, 0.1 ] );

// Poor scond triggers equilibration:
const equed = [ '' ];
zlaqhb.ndarray( 'upper', 4, 1, AB, 1, 2, 0, S, 1, 0, 0.02, 25.0, equed );

console.log( 'equed:', equed[ 0 ] ); // eslint-disable-line no-console
// => 'yes'

console.log( 'AB:', AB ); // eslint-disable-line no-console
```

</section>
